expected: Searchable categorized inserter inserts after the selected sibling or inside group/column/list containers, not at an unrelated location.
Typing slash at start/after whitespace in text opens inserter; selecting an item removes command slash and inserts after that text block.
Inserter only offers a sibling list item for a list-item context.
Deep duplication regenerates every descendant ID and leaves the source unchanged.
Paragraph/heading/quote/button transforms preserve text and links; button conversion requires one common href and maps it to the button URL.
Incompatible media/layout nodes cannot be destructively transformed in this phase.
Drag/drop and move controls reorder same-parent children; cross-parent drops are rejected.
Outline exposes nested children and selects/scrolls to the corresponding node.
Undo history remains capped at 50 snapshots and structural actions expose localized live status.
